Standard GCI approach (Roache):
- Fine: f1, medium: f2, coarse: f3, with grid ratios r21 and r32.
- Observed order p = ln((f3 - f2)/(f2 - f1)) / ln(r21) (assuming r21 ≈ r32).
- Richardson extrapolation: f_R = f1 + (f1 - f2)/(r21^p - 1).
- GCI_fine = 1.25 * |f1 - f2| / (r21^p - 1) (this is an approximate 95% confidence interval).
- GCI_extrapolated = 1.25 * |f_R - f1| / (r21^p - 1).
